token.label: API Key
token.description:
To get your PDF.co API key:
1. Sign in or create an account at [app.pdf.co](https://app.pdf.co/).
2. Open **API** in the left menu.
3. Copy the API key and paste it here.

add_image_to_pdf.label: Add Image to PDF
add_image_to_pdf.description: Add image to a PDF document.

url.label: Source PDF URL
url.description: URL of the PDF file to modify.

xCoordinate.label: X Coordinate
xCoordinate.description: X coordinate (from top-left corner) to place the image.

yCoordinate.label: Y Coordinate
yCoordinate.description: Y coordinate (from top-left corner) to place the image.

width.label: Width
width.description: Optional width for the image on the PDF (in points). Aspect ratio is kept by default.

height.label: Height
height.description: Optional height for the image on the PDF (in points). Aspect ratio is kept by default.

pages.label: Target Pages
pages.description: Page indexes as comma-separated values or ranges (first page is 0), e.g. "0, 1, 2-" or "1, 2, 3-7".

fileName.label: File Name
fileName.description: Desired name for the output PDF file (e.g., "result.pdf").

expiration.label: Expiration Time in Minutes
expiration.description: Set the expiration time for the output link in minutes (default is 60 i.e 60 minutes or 1 hour).

pdfPassword.label: Source PDF Password
pdfPassword.description: Password if the source PDF is protected.

httpUsername.label: HTTP Username
httpUsername.description: HTTP auth username if required to access source url.

httpPassword.label: HTTP Password
httpPassword.description: HTTP auth password if required to access source url.

saveOutputFile.label: Save Result as File
saveOutputFile.description: Download the result and keep it as a file in this flow, so later steps can use it after the PDF.co link expires (links last 60 minutes by default). Files over 100 MB are not saved; the link is still returned.

convert_html_to_pdf.label: Convert HTML to PDF
convert_html_to_pdf.description: Convert HTML code into a downloadable PDF document.

html.label: HTML Content
html.description: The HTML code to convert to PDF.

name.label: Output File Name
name.description: Desired name for the output PDF file (e.g., "result.pdf").

margins.label: Margins
margins.description: CSS style margins (e.g., "10px", "5mm 5mm 5mm 5mm" for top, right, bottom, left).

paperSize.label: Paper Size
paperSize.description: Select a standard paper size. For another size, fill Custom Paper Size below.

printBackground.label: Print Background ?
printBackground.description: Set to true to print background graphics and colors (default is true).

header.label: Header HTML
header.description: HTML content for the page header.

footer.label: Footer HTML
footer.description: HTML content for the page footer.

doNotWaitFullLoad.label: Do not wait till full page load ?

expiration.label: Output Link Expiration (minutes)
expiration.description: Set the expiration time for the output link in minutes (default is 60).

customPaperSize.label: Custom Paper Size
customPaperSize.description: Width and height with units, e.g. "200mm 300mm" or "8.5in 11in". Overrides Paper Size when set.

get_credit_balance.label: Get Credit Balance
get_credit_balance.description: Get the number of PDF.co credits left on the account.
